title: Tiny, cute flower pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Pot body -->
  <path d='M32 58 L36 88 L64 88 L68 58 Z' fill='#C0632A' />
  <!-- Pot rim -->
  <rect x='28' y='52' width='44' height='10' rx='3' fill='#E07B39' />
  <!-- Pot rim highlight -->
  <rect x='30' y='53' width='40' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#F0A060' />
  <!-- Pot body shade line -->
  <path d='M40 68 L44 88' stroke='#A0501E' stroke-width='2' fill='none' />
  <path d='M60 68 L56 88' stroke='#A0501E' stroke-width='2' fill='none' />
  <!-- Soil -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='15' ry='4' fill='#5C3A1E' />
  <!-- Stem -->
  <line x1='50' y1='58' x2='50' y2='36' stroke='#3DA843' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' />
  <!-- Left leaf -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='44' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#4CC85A' transform='rotate(-25 38 44)' />
  <!-- Right leaf -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='40' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#3DB84A' transform='rotate(25 62 40)' />
  <!-- Flower petals -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='26' r='7' fill='#FF5A8C' />
  <circle cx='42' cy='30' r='6' fill='#FF7AA8' />
  <circle cx='58' cy='30' r='6' fill='#FF7AA8' />
  <circle cx='44' cy='20' r='6' fill='#FF4A7C' />
  <circle cx='56' cy='20' r='6' fill='#FF4A7C' />
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='6' fill='#FF6A92' />
  <!-- Flower center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='25' r='4' fill='#FFD93B' />
  <!-- Little face on pot -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='72' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#F5F0E8' />
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='72' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#F5F0E8' />
  <circle cx='43' cy='72' r='1.2' fill='#3A2010' />
  <circle cx='57' cy='72' r='1.2' fill='#3A2010' />
  <path d='M46 79 Q50 83 54 79' stroke='#F5F0E8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' />
</svg>
